text:
Sasha Kim: FYI the sample-app started flipping errors on streaming fn-calls with JSON mode after yesterday's streaming endpoint change.
Ravi Patel: can you paste the error? sounds like a partial-JSON parse during the stream.
Sasha Kim: here's a snippet from staging: 
```
[data event] data: '{"tool_call": {"name": "index", "args": {"docs": ['
[data event] data: '"doc1", "doc2"]}}'
validator: SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
```
Sasha Kim: validator tries to JSON.parse each data event. with streaming we get fragments.
Joanna Park: oh we had this before for streaming completions. We solved it with a tiny framing helper in infra but it wasn't in SDKs.
Liam O'Connor: two options: (1) add framing at server side (length-prefixed frames) or (2) SDK-level collector that assembles top-level JSON objects before validating.
Ravi Patel: framing server-side is clean but a larger protocol change. For quick DX fix let's ship an SDK helper that collects a balanced top-level JSON value.
Sasha Kim: agreed. constraints: must not block forever for huge outputs, must expose partial behavior so apps can opt-in to incremental handling.
Joanna Park: proposed API sketch (TS):
```ts
for await (const evt of client.stream(...)) {
  const frame = await jsonFrameCollector(evt, {maxBytes: 256*1024, maxWaitMs: 300})
  if (frame.type === 'complete') {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(frame.payload)
    validate(parsed)
  } else {
    // {type: 'partial', payload: string}
    // app can log or append
  }
}
```
Ravi Patel: please ensure collector handles nested arrays/strings with braces, escaped quotes, and raw text nodes used in some tool outputs. Unit tests should include weird cases (e.g., '\"}}}}', big arrays, multiple JSON objects concatenated).
Sasha Kim: also add an option to return streaming tokens as they arrive while collector works in background for the top-level value, so client apps that need both low-latency token stream + schema validation can get both.
Joanna Park: parity note: implement same semantics in py (async iterator) and node (EventEmitter/AsyncIterable). Keep function name identical across SDKs, e.g., `collectTopLevelJson`.
Liam O'Connor: telemetry: emit metrics `jsonframe_bytes`, `jsonframe_latency_ms`, and `jsonframe_mode` (buffered|partial|fallback) so we can tune defaults.
Ravi Patel: fallback strategy: if maxBytes exceeded or maxWait reached, emit `partial` with `truncated=true` flag. Apps may choose to request full non-streaming call for reliability.
Sasha Kim: doc updates: sample-app onboarding needs a short note about streaming+json mode caveat and example using collector. Add example with fncall tool where tool returns NDJSON lines.
Joanna Park: tests: unit tests + integration in sample-app harness against a fake streaming endpoint that emits fragments in many orders. Add fuzz test with randomized chunk boundaries.
devex-bot: created issue #8482: "SDK JSON-framing collector + parity + telemetry" — add PR links to close.
Sasha Kim: I'll draft TS helper and tests today, open draft PR behind feature flag. Joanna, want the py follow-up?
Joanna Park: taking python. I'll mirror API and add async iterator example in sample-app's README.
Liam O'Connor: infra note: when retries happen, make sure validators are idempotent and we don't double-count validation errors in Sentry / logs.
Ravi Patel: good point. also add a lint to sample-app CI that runs the collector in both stream and non-stream modes to catch regressions.
Sasha Kim: thanks team. checklist before merge: unit tests, node+py parity, sample-app doc snippet, telemetry, feature flag, PR review. aiming to out to dev by EOD Fri behind flag.
Joanna Park: LGTM. :+1:
devex-bot: linked issue #8482 to project "sdk-dx-improvements" and assigned Sasha, Joanna, Ravi.
Sasha Kim: will post PR link when ready. if anyone wants to review early ping me in thread.
